title.en: A Border Collie needs at least two hours of exercise every day.
title.sl: Border collie potrebuje vsak dan vsaj dve uri gibanja.

why.en: That's why your adult dog's daily goal is 12,000 steps.
why.sl: Zato je dnevni cilj tvojega odraslega psa 12.000 korakov.

facts.quote: Your Collie will need a minimum of two hours exercise every day

title.en: In Stanley Coren's survey, 190 of 199 judges ranked the Border Collie in their top 10.
title.sl: V raziskavi Stanleyja Corena je 190 od 199 sodnikov border collieja uvrstilo med prvih 10.

why.en: That's why in the game your Border Collie learns commands twice as fast as a mixed breed.
why.sl: Zato se tvoj border collie v igri uči ukazov dvakrat hitreje kot mešanček.

facts.quote: 190 of the 199 judges ranked the Border Collie in the top 10.

title.en: Dog training sessions should be short: just five to 10 minutes, ending on a positive note.
title.sl: Vaja šolanja naj bo kratka: samo pet do 10 minut in naj se konča z nečim lepim.

why.en: That's why your dog trains for up to 5 minutes a day in the app.
why.sl: Zato tvoj kuža v aplikaciji vadi največ 5 minut na dan.

facts.quote: Always keep training sessions brief — just five to 10 minutes — and always end on a positive note.

title.en: A reward encourages a dog to do the behaviour you want.
title.sl: Nagrada psa spodbudi k vedenju, ki si ga želiš.

why.en: That's why you tap Praise right when your dog obeys.
why.sl: Zato pritisneš »Pohvali« takoj, ko kuža uboga.

facts.quote: Positive reinforcement is the process of giving a dog a reward to encourage the behavior you want.

title.en: Puppies can start very simple training as soon as they come home, usually at around 8 weeks old.
title.sl: Mladiček se lahko čisto preprostih stvari začne učiti takoj, ko pride domov, običajno pri približno 8 tednih.

why.en: Your puppy arrives at 8 weeks, so it starts every command from zero.
why.sl: Tvoj mladiček pride star 8 tednov, zato se vseh ukazov uči od začetka.

facts.quote: Puppies can begin very simple training starting as soon as they come home, usually around 8 weeks old.

title.en: Border Collies also need chances to solve problems and use their brains.
title.sl: Border collie potrebuje tudi priložnosti, da rešuje uganke in uporablja možgane.

why.en: Training games in the app are brain work for your dog.
why.sl: Vaje šolanja v aplikaciji so za tvojega kužka delo za možgane.

facts.quote: They also need opportunities to solve problems and use their brains.

title.en: Puppies aged eight to 12 weeks need four meals a day.
title.sl: Mladički, stari od osem do 12 tednov, potrebujejo štiri obroke na dan.

why.en: That's why your very young puppy has four meal times a day.
why.sl: Zato ima tvoj čisto majhen mladiček štiri obroke na dan.

facts.quote: Puppies eight to 12 weeks old need four meals a day.

title.en: Puppies aged three to six months need three meals a day.
title.sl: Mladički, stari od tri do šest mesecev, potrebujejo tri obroke na dan.

why.en: That's why your puppy gets three meal times a day from 3 months.
why.sl: Zato ima tvoj mladiček od 3. meseca tri obroke na dan.

facts.quote: Feed puppies three to six months old three meals a day.

title.en: A dog is a puppy until its fast growth stops, at around 6–9 months.
title.sl: Pes je mladiček, dokler ne neha hitro rasti — pri približno 6–9 mesecih.

why.en: In the game, your puppy becomes a young dog at 9 months.
why.sl: V igri tvoj mladiček pri 9 mesecih postane mlad pes.

facts.quote: From birth to cessation of rapid growth (~6–9 months, varying with breed and size)

title.en: A Border Collie needs to meet different people, places and sounds, step by step.
title.sl: Border collie mora postopoma spoznati različne ljudi, kraje in zvoke.

why.en: That's your weekly "New experience" task while your dog is a puppy.
why.sl: Zato imaš vsak teden nalogo »Nova izkušnja«, dokler je kuža mladiček.

facts.quote: You'll need to gradually introduce them to different people, places, sounds and experiences.

title.en: A Border Collie without enough exercise may show it is unhappy by chewing things.
title.sl: Border collie, ki nima dovolj gibanja, lahko pokaže, da je nesrečen, tako da grize stvari.

why.en: That's why a missed walk can mean a chewed slipper the next day.
why.sl: Zato lahko zamujen sprehod naslednji dan pomeni pregrizen copat.

facts.quote: If left alone or not given enough exercise, your Collie will certainly let you know they’re unhappy by chewing anything in paw’s reach!

title.en: When the work is done, Border Collies like to settle down for cuddle time.
title.sl: Ko je delo opravljeno, se border collie rad umiri in crklja.

why.en: When the care is done, a cuddle in the app makes your dog happy.
why.sl: Ko je skrb opravljena, kužka razveseli crkljanje v aplikaciji.

facts.quote: These energetic dogs will settle down for cuddle time when the workday is done.

title.en: The Border Collie's name comes from the border area between England and Scotland.
title.sl: Ime border collie izvira iz obmejnih krajev med Anglijo in Škotsko.

facts.quote: Their name comes from the border regions of England and Scotland

title.en: The Border Collie is a sheepdog from Great Britain.
title.sl: Border collie je ovčarski pes iz Velike Britanije.

facts.quote: ORIGIN: Great-Britain. … UTILIZATION: Sheepdog.

title.en: Border Collies were developed to make their own decisions while managing livestock over large areas.
title.sl: Border collieje so vzrejali, da se sami odločajo, ko vodijo živino na velikih površinah.

facts.quote: The Border Collie was developed to make independent decisions while managing livestock over large areas.

title.en: Herding is deep in a Border Collie's nature.
title.sl: Vodenje črede je border collieju v krvi.

facts.quote: Herding is deep in their nature

title.en: A Border Collie controls livestock with an intense stare called the "eye" and a stalking way of moving.
title.sl: Border collie obvladuje živino z ostrim pogledom, ki mu pravijo »oko«, in s plazečim se gibanjem.

facts.source_name: AKC breed standard (Border Collie Society of America)
facts.quote: The stock is then controlled with an intense gaze known as “eye”, coupled with a stalking style of movement.

title.en: A Border Collie can suddenly change speed and direction and still keep its balance.
title.sl: Border collie lahko nenadoma spremeni hitrost in smer, pa vseeno ohrani ravnotežje.

facts.source_name: AKC breed standard (Border Collie Society of America)
facts.quote: The Border Collie is an agile dog, able to suddenly change speed and direction while maintaining balance and grace.

title.en: Endurance is the Border Collie's trademark.
title.sl: Vzdržljivost je zaščitni znak border collieja.

facts.source_name: AKC breed standard (Border Collie Society of America)
facts.quote: Endurance is its trademark.

title.en: The ideal height of a male Border Collie is 53 cm at the shoulders; females are slightly smaller.
title.sl: Idealna višina samca border collieja je 53 cm do vihra; samice so nekoliko nižje.

facts.quote: Ideal height at withers: Males: 53 cm (21 ins), Females: slightly less.

title.en: Border Collies have one of two coat types: moderately long or smooth.
title.sl: Border collie ima eno od dveh vrst dlake: srednje dolgo ali gladko.

facts.quote: Hair: Two varieties: Moderately long or Smooth.

title.en: A Border Collie's dense top coat and soft, thick undercoat protect it well from the weather.
title.sl: Gosta krovna dlaka in mehka, gosta podlanka border collieja ga dobro varujeta pred vremenom.

facts.quote: In both, topcoat dense and medium textured, undercoat soft and dense giving good weather resistance.

title.en: A Border Collie carries its ears upright or half upright.
title.sl: Border collie nosi ušesa pokončno ali napol pokončno.

facts.quote: Carried erect or semi-erect and sensitive in use.

title.en: A Border Collie's tail is set low and has an upward swirl at the end.
title.sl: Rep border collieja je nizko nasajen in se na koncu zavihne navzgor.

facts.quote: Moderately long, the bone reaching at least to hock, set on low, well-furnished and with an upward swirl towards the end,

title.en: Puzzle feeders are great for Border Collies.
title.sl: Igrače z ugankami za hrano so za border collieja odlične.

facts.quote: Puzzle feeders are great for Collies.

title.en: Border Collies are very loving with their families.
title.sl: Border collie je do svoje družine zelo ljubeč.

facts.quote: Border Collies are extremely loving with their families.

title.en: Brushing a Border Collie a couple of times a week helps remove dead hairs.
title.sl: Če border collieja krtačiš nekajkrat na teden, odstraniš odmrle dlake.

facts.quote: Brushing your Collie's fur a couple of times a week should help keep on top of the dead hairs

title.en: In a Dogs Trust study, Border Collies had a median life expectancy of 13.1 years.
title.sl: V raziskavi Dogs Trust je bila mediana pričakovane življenjske dobe border collieja 13,1 leta.

why.en: Game rule: PetPrep applies the last-25% rule to this figure, so your dog becomes a senior at 118 months.
why.sl: Pravilo igre: PetPrep na to številko uporabi pravilo zadnjih 25 %, zato vaš pes postane starejši pri 118 mesecih.

facts.quote: Across all purebred dogs, median life expectancy was 12.7 years. … dogs with typical shaped faces e.g., Border Collie (13.1 years)

title.en: AAHA guidelines define a dog's senior stage as the last 25% of its estimated lifespan.
title.sl: Smernice AAHA obdobje starejšega psa opredelijo kot zadnjih 25 % njegove pričakovane življenjske dobe.

why.en: That's how the game sets the senior stage for each breed.
why.sl: Tako igra določi začetek starosti pri vsaki pasmi.

facts.quote: From the last 25% of estimated lifespan through end-of-life.

title.en: According to PDSA, Border Collies might not be the best dogs for first-time owners.
title.sl: Po navedbah PDSA border collie morda ni najprimernejši pes za tiste, ki imajo psa prvič.

facts.quote: While they might not be the best dogs for first time owners

title.en: PDSA does not recommend a Border Collie for families with smaller children.
title.sl: PDSA border collieja ne priporoča družinam z manjšimi otroki.

facts.quote: We wouldn't recommend a Collie if you have smaller children

title.en: According to Battersea, Border Collies can be a great fit for families with older children.
title.sl: Po navedbah Battersea se border collie lahko odlično znajde v družini s starejšimi otroki.

facts.quote: Border Collies can be a great fit for families with older children

title.en: Like many dogs, Border Collies do not cope well on their own.
title.sl: Kot mnogi psi border collie slabo prenaša samoto.

facts.quote: Like many dogs, Collies don't do well on their own.

title.en: A Border Collie may try to herd other pets, so it is important to supervise them together.
title.sl: Border collie lahko poskuša voditi druge živali v hiši kot čredo, zato jih je dobro nadzorovati.

facts.quote: However, you might find they try to herd them to it’s important to supervise your Collie with other pets.

title.en: Border Collies may try to herd or chase cars, other dogs, cyclists, joggers or children.
title.sl: Border collie lahko poskuša voditi ali loviti avtomobile, druge pse, kolesarje, tekače ali otroke.

facts.quote: This can sometimes lead to trying to herd or chase cars, other dogs, cyclists, joggers or children.

title.en: Without enough physical and mental activity, Border Collies can get frustrated and start chasing or herding.
title.sl: Brez dovolj telesne in miselne dejavnosti je border collie lahko frustriran in začne loviti ali voditi.

why.en: This is why the daily step goal matters for this breed.
why.sl: Zato je pri tej pasmi dnevni cilj korakov tako pomemben.

facts.quote: Without enough physical and mental stimulation, Border Collies can become frustrated and start chasing or herding.

title.en: During shedding season, the AKC advises brushing a Border Collie daily.
title.sl: V času menjave dlake AKC svetuje, da border collieja krtačite vsak dan.

facts.quote: Prospective owners should expect to brush their Border Collie daily during shedding season.

title.en: A genetics study found that breed explains just 9% of behaviour differences between individual dogs.
title.sl: Genetska raziskava je pokazala, da pasma pojasni le 9 % razlik v vedenju med posameznimi psi.

why.en: Every dog is an individual: the breed is only part of the story.
why.sl: Vsak pes je svoja osebnost: pasma pove le del zgodbe.

facts.quote: Breed explains just 9% of behavioral variation in individuals.

title.en: PDSA advises starting positive, reward-based training with a Border Collie from an early age.
title.sl: PDSA svetuje, da z border colliejem že zgodaj začnete s pozitivnim šolanjem z nagradami.

facts.quote: It's important to start positive, reward-based training from an early age

title.en: Collie eye anomaly is an inherited eye condition; its effect ranges from mild vision changes to sight loss.
title.sl: Anomalija očesa pri collijih je dedna bolezen oči; učinek sega od blagih sprememb vida do izgube vida.

facts.quote: Collie Eye Anomaly is an inherited eye condition that can range from mild changes in vision to significant sight loss.

title.en: Epilepsy is seen more commonly in Border Collies.
title.sl: Epilepsija se pri border collieju pojavlja pogosteje.

facts.quote: Epilepsy is seen more commonly in Border Collies and can cause seizures.

title.en: Border Collies can develop hip dysplasia, which can affect how comfortably they move.
title.sl: Pri border collieju se lahko razvije displazija kolkov, ki lahko vpliva na gibanje.

facts.quote: Border Collies can develop conditions such as hip dysplasia, which can cause pain and mobility problems.
